description: Use this when the user asks which banks, account types or provinces BLIA covers, how many accounts it holds, or when it was last updated -- or before saying BLIA does not cover something. No arguments. Returns each covered bank with its product classes, product and variant counts and provinces; the product classes covered and not covered; the kinds of information not covered; and last_update (when the snapshot was built and when a bank source was last read). A bank, class or province not listed is outside BLIA's snapshot, which says nothing about whether the bank offers it. For the accounts themselves use list_bank_products.
name: list_coverage

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

freshness_warning.description: Repeats freshness.guidance when the snapshot is not current.
